Every angle. Every frame. Measured to the degree.

Precision Swing breaks your swing down to the finest detail: shoulder, hip, spine and arm angles at all ten positions, tempo to the hundredth of a second, every frame of the motion. Then set it beside real tour swings to see exactly where you differ from the pros, and the drill that closes each gap.

For the sharpest analysis, film in Slo-mo in the Camera app, then tap Upload a video.

Add Precision Swing to your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Live drills with your camera work from there.

Swing like a pro

How to film

  • Use slo-mo if you can (120 or 240 fps). It sharpens every position and the sequence chart.
  • Phone at hip height, about 3 m (10 ft) away. A tripod or bag stand beats a friend’s hands.
  • Keep your whole body and the club in frame from address to finish.
  • Hit as many as you like in one recording. Start filming, walk in, swing, walk back. Each swing is found and trimmed for you.

Recent swings

Your video stays on your phone; body tracking runs on the device. Four pro swings are motion-captured from slow-motion footage; the rest are modelled from published swing measurements (turn, backswing length, tempo, footwork). None are affiliated with or endorsed by the players.

Pro library

Each model is a full 3D swing. Study it face-on or down the line, then lay it over your own swing, matched at every P position.

Tiger Woods, Collin Morikawa and Nelly Korda iron swings, and Tiger’s driver, are motion-captured from slow-motion footage. The others are modelled from published swing measurements. None are affiliated with or endorsed by the players named.

Drills

Every measure in your analysis links here. Do a drill until you get 5 good reps in a row, then film a swing to re-test. Drills marked Live feedback use your camera and chime on every good rep.
